scientific_integrity: Two standalone independent constructions enumerate all 2048 valid cycles, with independent graph metric confirmation; no claims of independent scholarly audit.
scientific_limitations: Order-five binary cycles only, rotations identified but not complements or reversals. General cross-join connectivity and a degree spectrum are prior work. Exact census has been computed and replayed, not independently validated or established as historically unique.
title: Shortest-path spectrum and center of the fifth-order binary de Bruijn cross-join graph
